website.source: Squarespace Analytics until the Vercel cutover; Vercel Web Analytics afterwards
website.note: Pending: Squarespace export for Jan-<cutover>; Vercel Web Analytics if it was enabled before the cutover.

analytics.source: Voiceflow Analytics API (query_project_transcript_count, query_unique_user_count, query_project_interaction_count), monthly buckets, America/New_York

transcripts.source: Voiceflow Transcripts API (search + get, filterConversation=true); one record per session
transcripts.window: 2026-03-16 to 2026-06-30 only (earlier transcripts expired). Use for rates and splits, not for period totals.
transcripts.pending_recompute: Figures predate the team test-handset exclusion (added Sep 2026). Re-run scripts/impact-assistant-usage.mjs before publishing.

caveats: Period totals (sessions, users, interactions) come from the Analytics block and cover the full six months.

Channel split, engaged rate, countries and languages come from the Transcripts block and cover 16 Mar - 30 Jun 2026 only; the April Analytics count (104) reconciles exactly with the transcripts fetched for April.
WhatsApp traffic Jan-May 2026 ran through FlowBridge into the web agent and is included in the web agent's Analytics totals; from June 2026 it has its own agent.

methodology.session: One Voiceflow transcript = one session (a widget load or a WhatsApp thread).
methodology.engaged_conversation: A session with at least one user message AND at least one assistant reply, and no runtime error message. Sessions where only the greeting fired are NOT engaged.
methodology.test_exclusions: Excluded: synthetic WhatsApp ids (wa:smoke-*, wa:probe-*), Voiceflow test-console sessions on the WhatsApp agent, the relay smoke-test prompt, and SCKIN's own test handset (matched on the last four digits of the number; the number itself is never stored here). The Elevate licensee project (69a791fd828521eb0b1349d7) is excluded from SCKIN's figures by decision, Sep 2026 — it reported zero sessions in any case.
methodology.channel: web = Voiceflow modality 'chat' on the web agent; whatsapp = modality 'api' on the web agent (FlowBridge era, to May 2026) or any 'api' session on the WhatsApp agent (Jun 2026 onward).
methodology.country: Web: Voiceflow's vf-country property (only populated from mid-April 2026, so earlier web sessions are 'unknown'). WhatsApp: derived from the phone number's international dialling code; the number itself is never stored.
methodology.language: Automatic language identification (py3langid) on the first user message of each engaged conversation; messages under 12 characters are skipped. Indicative only.
methodology.unique_users_monthly_sum: Voiceflow reports unique users per month; the period figure is the sum of monthly uniques, so a person active in two months counts twice.
methodology.retention: Voiceflow keeps transcripts for 6 months. Transcript-level metrics can only be recomputed for the trailing 6 months; the Analytics API series goes back to the agent's creation (June 2025).
